ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulumul Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.
   D. Say Ulumul Qur’an has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum ,.
   D. Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Tawhid? (1 mark)

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
